name: @repo/erp-browser
description: Host layer: bundles selected capabilities into a browser-loadable module (site/erp-factory.js) and a Node twin (site/erp-factory.cjs) so the static ERP can consume the same typed domain code the factory composes. Not a capability — it is a host, like packages/factory and apps/web, and is therefore outside the boundary linter's layer matrix.
